say:2:1720714001:1.text: Hey, you almost gave yourself away just now, you know?
say:2:1720714001:1.source_cn: 喂，笨蛋公主，你刚才差点就露馅了。

say:3:1720714002:1.text: It just breaks my heart to see Susan pushing herself so hard! W-What if she collapses from pulling an all-nighter?
say:3:1720714002:1.source_cn: 我只是不想让她那么辛苦嘛！她都那个样子了，要是再熬夜赶...

say:4:1720714003:1.text: And I was going to cancel the banquet anyway...
say:4:1720714003:1.source_cn: 而且，我本来就想取消宴会，她却还在那么辛苦地为宴会准备...

say:5:1720714004:1.text: I know you mean well, Peggy, but do you know what matters most to a craftsman?
say:5:1720714004:1.source_cn: 我知道你是好心。但是，佩吉，你知道对于一个手艺人来说，...

say:7:1720714006:1.text: ... Health is important, of course, but I think Susan values integrity and recognition even more.
say:7:1720714006:1.source_cn: ……健康当然也很重要啦，但我想对苏珊婆婆来说，最重要的...

say:8:1720714007:1.text: She'll do her best to fulfill the order as long as it still stands. If you make her stop now, you'd be undermining her efforts and causing her to lose the royal court's trust.
say:8:1720714007:1.source_cn: 只要订单没有取消，哪怕再怎么努力也要完成，这就是我们生...

say:9:1720714008:1.text: Rather than getting rest, I think she'd prefer to see you shine at the banquet, wearing the brooch she made. That would be the best reward she could ask for.
say:9:1720714008:1.source_cn: 再说了，比起休息，我想她更希望看到的，是你戴着她亲手制...

say:10:1720714009:1.text: ... Hmph, I don't care about looking good at the banquet.

say:11:1720714010:1.text: ... Fine, that didn't occur to me.
say:11:1720714010:1.source_cn: ……好吧好吧，这次是我考虑不周了。

say:12:1720714011:1.text: Well, this is rare. I was expecting a comeback from you.
say:12:1720714011:1.source_cn: 公主殿下今天竟然不嘴硬，这可太难得了。

say:13:1720714012:1.text: Alright, I'm good to go. As a man of my word, I'll accompany you for the day.
say:13:1720714012:1.source_cn: 商会的事情就忙到这儿吧，我也不想失信于人，既然签了条约...

say:14:1720714013:1.text: Actually, I don't have a specific destination in mind yet... Let's just head out and see where we end up.
say:14:1720714013:1.source_cn: 我也不知道要去哪儿……总之，我们先随便出门逛逛吧。
